title: Расскажи Гарри Поттеру о себе
description: Заполни пропуски и расскажи о своём дне

sections.name: Morning
prompts: In the morning, I wake up at …
After breakfast I go to school and …

sections.name: School and day
prompts: At school I usually … (study English / play with my friends / have lunch)
In the afternoon I come home and …
After school I do my homework and …

sections.name: Evening
prompts: In the evening I … (watch TV / play computer games / read books)
I have dinner with … (my family / my mum and dad)
After dinner I … (talk to my friends / work on the computer / play with my pet)

sections.name: Night / weekend
prompts: At night I go to bed at … and … (read a book / listen to music)
At the weekend I … (go to the park / visit my grandparents / play football)
